chief_complaint.text: Fever, cough, body pain, sore throat, and fatigue for 3 days.

history_of_present_illness.text: Fever started 3 days ago, initially mild but increased to 101 °F yesterday evening. Took Paracetamol 650 mg twice yesterday which provided temporary relief. Cough is mostly dry with occasional mucus. Patient reports slight breathlessness when climbing stairs but denies chest pain, wheezing, and severe shortness of breath. Denies loss of smell or taste, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and burning during urination. Patient was in contact with a sick office colleague (viral fever) last week.

advice.text: Drink plenty of fluids, get adequate rest, and eat soft nutritious food. Wear a mask around family members to reduce transmission. Visit the nearest emergency department immediately if experiencing difficulty breathing, persistent high fever above 102 °F, oxygen saturation below 94%, severe chest pain, or confusion.
